summary: DMFI PAC, the hybrid PAC for Democratic Majority for Israel, endorsed Marni von Wilpert in March 2026 as "strongly pro-Israel" with "great relationships and records with the community," and reaffirmed the pick under its Majority Project in June. Her platform references a two-state solution but is framed around rebuilding alliances and supporting NATO; Vote for Peace rates her Opposed. The explicit pro-Israel organizational alignment drives the assessment.
